original_question:
Write the Verilog code for the following two modules:

1.  A 1-bit full adder module named `full_adder`. This module should have three 1-bit inputs, `A`, `B`, and `Cin`, and two 1-bit outputs, `Sum` and `Cout`.
2.  A 2-to-1 multiplexer module named `mux2`. This module should have three 1-bit inputs, `I0`, `I1`, and `S`, and one 1-bit output, `O`. The output `O` should select between `I0` and `I1` based on the value of the select input `S`.
